pairs.claim_text: President Trump's tough rhetoric on border enforcement led to a decrease in illegal border crossings.

pairs.assumption_text: The political establishment in Washington D.C. opposes effective immigration enforcement.
pairs.claim_text: Political figures in Washington, D.C., are deeply entrenched and resistant to reform.
